questions.stem: How does laser eye surgery correct vision defects?

options.text: It replaces the lens with an artificial one
It changes the shape of the cornea to alter how light is refracted
It makes the eyeball longer or shorter

questions.explanation: Laser eye surgery reshapes the cornea using a laser beam. By changing the curvature of the cornea, the way light is refracted can be corrected so it focuses precisely on the retina.
